Yes, the Steam Frame price is (just) over $1k
Valve's Steam Frame pricing starts at $1,059
Valve decided that cutting the Steam Frame’s specs to avoid price rises wasn't "the right product choice" for the VR headset
Steam Frame review: Another best-in-class VR headset by Valve, though virtual realities clash with economic ones
Valve’s Steam Frame VR headset opens for orders, with the cheapest model priced at a lenswatering £889 / $1,059

facts.context: The developer recently opened up pre-order registration for the £889 / $1,059 standalone headset following months of wait.
If you want to pick one of those as well it'll cost you another $29 / £29, though any 45W+ USB-C charger will have you sorted.
I don't think taking that stance that means making excuses for just how expensive the Frame is; the 1TB version I tested is £1,089 / $1,299, almost double the UK price of a top-spec Quest 3.

Also available are the Steam Frame Ergonomic Accessories Kit ($59 / £59) - which includes two controller hand straps / battery doors, a headset top strap and extended light blocker - and the Steam Frame Accessory Replacement Kit ($49 / £49) to swap out the face gasket and head cushion once they become worn.

singleSourced.value: Frame isn't a machine for high-end enthusiasts
singleSourced.context: Despite being impressed with the hardware design and capabilities of the headset in Eurogamer's review of Steam Frame, Matt Wales said "Frame isn't a machine for high-end enthusiasts" and "doesn't offer a dramatically different in-headset experience to the far cheaper, more intuitive Quest 3".

Yes, the rumored $1k+ price point is in fact a reality, which isn't really all that much of a surprise given how pretty much every gaming machine component under the sun has increased in price over the last five years.

singleSourced.context: The Steam Frame sports plenty of fancy tech, including foveated rendering that "optimizes detail where your eyes are looking" and multi-link streaming which sends your data across all available connection points to improve consistency.
At just $10 more than the base model of Valve's own (and already pricey) Steam Machine, the Steam Frame price is, without question, expensive.
The new virtual reality device will cost $1,059 for a basic 256GB model, while a 1TB model will cost $1,200.
